text:
Alex K: morning — quick async sprint spotlight for kernel/batching/kv.
Alex K: landed `opt/microbatch-fanout` branch yesterday. Local perf: p50 18ms -> 13ms, p99 145ms -> 112ms on r4-large. Planning a canary rollout tonight if no regressions. Blocker: KV warmup tests hitting OOM in sim. @Priya S can you look at eviction/prefetch window? :eyes:

Priya S: on it. reproducing locally now. looks like warmup prefetch window sometimes overshoots and fills mem. suspect my prefetch window default (256) is too aggressive. will try 128 and re-run.

Jun T: pushed a tiny scheduler fix to avoid double-enqueue (PR #4321). low-risk but needs a quick review.

Marta R: grabbing Jun's PR now. also saw CI bench job failing earlier — harness missing env.

ci-bot: Pipeline bench-runs/983 failed — step `run-bench.sh` exited 1. ERROR: MISSING_ENV BENCH_REGION

Alex K: thx. I added a temporary fallback in bench script to default to eu-west-1 so we can continue runs. @Devops please add BENCH_REGION to the bench service account creds permanently.

Devops: noted, I'll add BENCH_REGION to the service account by EOD and update infra docs.

Priya S: reduced prefetch window to 128 locally — KV warmup completes, no OOM. uploading diff and test logs to the PR.

Alex K: excellent. after Priya's change we should re-run canary. who can watch logs at 20:00 PT and be ready to rollback if kv.warmup.error spikes?

Jun T: I can monitor. I'll create an alert: `kv.warmup.error_rate > 0.5%` and route to #eng-runtime and my phone.

Marta R: small ask — review queue for kernel scheduler currently has 3 pending PRs. can we aim to clear by EOD to avoid blocking the rollout?

Alex K: will triage and prioritize them. note: microbatch change introduced a new flag `batch.max_group_tokens` — we need a short docs blurb in /docs/serving/batching.md.

Priya S: I'll add docs note and a sample config snippet.

Alex K: thanks. summary: perf looks good, OOM blocker fixed by Priya, bench env fallback applied, Devops will add env var, Jun monitors canary. No other blockers from me. :thumbsup:

Marta R: ack. ping if anything flares during canary.

Alex K: closing this async check-in.
